actual: September active release requires combining already independently validated physical minute files, 14 daily pre-close references, 8702 sector H5 facts and matching static cells while preserving the late-financing correction and unchanged pins. Existing adoption accepts only narrow financing/minute/catalog proof types and cannot register one complete mixed correction without intermediate activation or rebuilding. Add minimal typed combined correction support and assembly under existing API; preserve exact active predecessor/CAS, immutable releases, unchanged bytes, finite fact preservation and no database/runtime writes. Reuse previously completed exact-key and full-window coverage receipts, no new full-market audit or re-export.
